 <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re</note> de ni mi rigs te gzugs brnyan gyi don gang yin | de rang rgyud pa'i rgyud la skye ba bzhin du dmyigs <choice><orig>bcan</orig><reg>pa can</reg></choice> <note type="editorial">"bcan" could also be read as "bcas"</note><note type="gloss">°°</note> du skye ba yin naM | 'on te mi dmyigs pa'i rnam pas de dag gi laM yon tan yar ldan du rgyud la skyed pa la bya | 
 dang po ni ma yin te dmyigs <pb edRef="inst:4454" n="132a"/><lb edRef="inst:4454" n="132a1"/> pa ni sgro 'dogs pa yin pas | byang chub seMs dpa' de spangs pa yang de skyed par ji ltar 'gyur |
 gnyis pa yang ma yin te | mi dmyigs pa'i rnaM pa can de byang chub seMs dpa'i <note type="gloss">sa brgyad °°°</note> sa × <note type="gloss">sa °°° la sogs pa</note> 'og mar yang rgyud la skyed par mi nus pa ci yod <note type="gloss">te bsdus pa'o</note>|| 
 de ni gzugs <choice><orig>rnyan</orig><reg>brnyan</reg></choice> gyi don gzhi rkyang shes pa la zer ba yin skad do || </seg></TEI>
